text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Customs (Offices and Stations) Regulations.

heading.en: Customs offices and customs stations generally
Customs offices and customs stations for separate and exclusive import, export and transhipment

text.en:
3.—(1) The following are customs offices and customs stations reserved for the separate and exclusive import, export and transhipment of goods by air by Federal Express (Singapore) Pte Ltd:
(a)all such part of ACE Hub under the possession and management of Federal Express (Singapore) Pte Ltd;
(b)all Customs Gate Stations and Offices within the part of ACE Hub mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a).
(2) [Deleted by S 674/2024 wef 01/09/2024]
(3) In this regulation, “ACE Hub” means the Air Cargo Express Hub within the Air Cargo Express Free Trade Zone at Changi Airport.
[S 674/2024 wef 01/09/2024]
[S 338/2018 wef 02/06/2018]
